intro.description: This Privacy Policy sets out the procedures for collecting, using, storing, transferring and protecting the personal data of users of the Repatria Europe website (hereinafter, the “Website”).
intro.controller_after: (hereinafter, “Repatria Europe”, “we”, “us”), which provides international repatriation, transportation of the deceased and related services.
intro.consent: By using the Website, submitting an enquiry, calling us or sending us a message, you confirm that you have read this Policy.

paragraphs.text: When using the Website and contacting us, we may receive personal data that you provide voluntarily:
items: first name or full name;
phone number;
email address;
country and locality of departure;
country and locality of destination;
information required to arrange transportation;
preferred transportation date;
the content of your enquiry and any other information you provide voluntarily.

paragraphs.text: Please provide only the personal data and information necessary to process your enquiry, provide consultation or arrange the relevant services.
Personal data is processed to the extent necessary for:
items: processing applications and enquiries;
contacting you regarding your enquiry;
providing consultations regarding Repatria Europe services;
arranging international repatriation, transportation and related assistance;
agreeing on the route, timing and other terms of service;
preparing, entering into and performing contracts;
complying with applicable legal requirements.

paragraphs.text: Personal data is not used for purposes incompatible with those for which it was collected, unless otherwise permitted by law or separately consented to by the user.
Personal data is processed in accordance with applicable data protection legislation.
Depending on the circumstances, the legal basis for processing personal data may include:
items: your consent to the processing of personal data;
the need to take steps at your request before entering into a contract;
entering into and performing a contract;
compliance with legal obligations;
the legitimate interests of Repatria Europe, provided they are not overridden by your rights and interests.

sections.title: How We Use and Store Data

paragraphs.text: Personal data is used only to the extent necessary to achieve the purposes set out in this Policy.
Personal data is retained only for as long as necessary to process an enquiry, provide services, fulfil contractual obligations or comply with legal requirements.
Once the purpose of processing has been fulfilled or consent has been withdrawn, and where there is no other lawful basis for continued retention, personal data is deleted or anonymized.
We take appropriate organizational and technical measures to protect personal data against unauthorized access, loss, alteration, disclosure or other unlawful use.

sections.title: Disclosure of Data to Third Parties

paragraphs.text: We do not sell personal data or disclose it to third parties for their own advertising purposes.
Personal data may be disclosed or accessed only to the extent necessary to operate the Website, process an enquiry or provide requested services, including by:
items: hosting, email and other technical service providers;
partners and contractors directly involved in arranging transportation, repatriation and related assistance;
government, consular and other authorized authorities where necessary to provide services or required by law.

paragraphs.text: Persons granted access to personal data receive only the information necessary to perform the relevant functions or provide the relevant services.
Third-party technical services, including hosting and email delivery services, may be used to provide certain Website functions.
The Website may contain links to third-party websites, platforms or services. You access such links at your own discretion.
This Policy does not govern how third-party resources process personal data. We recommend reviewing their respective privacy policies.
Subject to applicable data protection law, you may have the right to:
items: receive information about the processing of your personal data;
access your personal data;
request correction of inaccurate or outdated data;
request deletion of personal data where provided for by law;
withdraw previously given consent to personal data processing;
object to personal data processing where provided for by law.

paragraphs.text: To exercise your rights, you may contact the personal data controller using the contact details provided on the Website.
For questions regarding this Policy, the processing of personal data or the exercise of your rights, you may contact the personal data controller:
Repatria Europe may periodically amend or supplement this Privacy Policy.
The current version of this Policy is always published on this page of the Website together with the date of the latest update.
